title: Docs: Add AWS Marketplace onboarding guide + FAQ
author: Kira Thompson
description:
Adds a new AWS Marketplace onboarding page for Redwood Inference with prerequisites, purchase -> entitlement -> org linking steps, and a troubleshooting-oriented FAQ aimed at reducing first-week support tickets. This is part of the Cloud Marketplace listing refresh workstream.

What’s included: (1) New docs page: “Buy via AWS Marketplace” covering prerequisites (Redwood org/admin access, AWS payer account considerations, supported regions), the step-by-step purchase flow, and what to expect during entitlement activation (timing + status indicators in Console). (2) New troubleshooting FAQ based on common issues we’ve seen in tickets and partner feedback (entitlement delays, wrong org linked, region mismatch, multiple AWS accounts/payers, and billing/invoice questions). (3) Cross-links from Getting Started + Pricing/Packaging to the new page, and a short in-page callout about when to contact Support vs wait for activation.

Non-goals: This PR does not change any backend provisioning behavior, webhook handling, or Console UX. It documents the current flow and sets expectations (including known propagation delays) while ENG-4401/4403/4407 ship.

Security/compliance language notes: Wording is intentionally scoped to avoid over-promising. We link to the Security FAQ and include shared responsibility / “configuration dependent” caveats. Marcus reviewed the phrasing around encryption, audit logs, and data retention.

Screenshots: Uses placeholder screenshots (redacted) for Console entitlement status and org linking. Final images will be updated in DES-212; this PR keeps filenames stable so we can drop-in replacements without reworking content.

Acceptance criteria: Page is discoverable from Docs nav and Pricing, includes a minimal “What you need before you buy” section, provides copy/paste-friendly customer instructions, and includes troubleshooting steps + support escalation path.

Follow-ups: GCP variant in PR-4829; add redirects from legacy marketplace doc stub once both go live; revisit FAQ once partner review finalizes exact AWS listing phrasing.

Refs: Linear ENG-4404; Support tickets SUP-18420 (entitlement delay) + SUP-18433 (wrong org linked); internal messaging framework for marketplaces; security packet draft for consistent terminology.
